findings.description: HeadersType was widened from MutableMapping[str, str | bytes] to Mapping[str, object], which loosens the type contract for headers.
findings.rationale: Type-only change: no runtime path is altered, and the widened alias means static checking no longer rejects non-string header values that the runtime code later expects to be str or bytes. This is a type-level concern rather than a demonstrated behavioral defect.
